sources.title: HM Treasury, The Green Book 2026
sections_read: Shortlist appraisal: Sensitivity analysis and switching values
sources.use: Methodological support for separating dates, monetary and unpriced effects, and conditional parameter tests. No empirical lunar market or engineering calibration.
sources.limits: Selected sections, not a full scholarly source review. Project constant discount rates are sensitivities; the official declining social-rate schedule is not adopted.
